name: Headspace Health
one_liner: Enterprise mental wellness combining Headspace mindfulness with clinical coaching and therapy.
best_for: Employers wanting combined mindfulness and clinical mental health benefits
Organizations seeking population-wide mental health support (not just crisis care)
Companies with diverse workforces needing BIPOC-representative providers
Employers wanting fast access to coaching (2 minutes) and therapy (1 day)
Organizations replacing traditional EAPs with modern, engaging solutions
not_for: Those in crisis who need immediate emergency care (call 988)
People who prefer in-person therapy exclusively
short_description: Headspace Health combines mindfulness app with clinical mental health services for employers, offering coaching and therapy.
long_description: Headspace Health is an enterprise mental wellness platform formed from the 2021 merger of Headspace (the mindfulness meditation app) and Ginger (a virtual mental health provider). The combined company offers employers a full continuum of mental health support, from self-guided mindfulness content through the Headspace app to on-demand coaching, therapy, and psychiatry services. Headspace Health emphasizes fast access to care with coaching available in minutes and therapy appointments typically within one day. The platform is designed to support population-wide mental wellness rather than just crisis intervention, making it popular as a modern EAP replacement.
